⇒ \(7 \frac{1}{4} - \left[ \frac{5}{6} \div \left\{ \frac{1}{3} - \left( \frac{1}{2} \times \left( \frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{2} \right) \right) \right\} \right]\)

From a sample of 200 software engineers, determine the ratio of those proficient in Python to those proficient in Java using the given information:

Category Number
Proficient in Python and Java 50
Proficient in Python only 70
Proficient in Java only 60
Proficient in neither language 20
questions.solution:
Given:

Total engineers = 200

Python only = 70

Java only = 60

Both Python and Java = 50

Neither = 20

Total Python ⇒ 70 + 50 = 120

Total Java ⇒ 60 + 50 = 110

Ratio ⇒ 120 : 110 = 12 : 11

questions.question: What is the average of all integers between 100 and 250 that are exactly divisible by 11?
questions.questionHtml: What is the average of all integers between 100 and 250 that are exactly divisible by 11?
questions.solution:
Smallest multiple of 11 greater than 100 ⇒ 11 × 10 = 110

Largest multiple of 11 less than 250 ⇒ 11 × 22 = 242

Average = (110 + 242) ÷ 2 = 176

questions.question: A is able to complete a task in 15 days, while B takes 20 days to finish the same task. If they collaborate and work together for 4 days, what fraction of the work will still remain?
questions.questionHtml: A is able to complete a task in 15 days, while B takes 20 days to finish the same task. If they collaborate and work together for 4 days, what fraction of the work will still remain?
questions.solution:
LCM of 15 and 20 = 60

Total Work = 60 units

Efficiency of A = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of B = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/day

Combined efficiency = 4 + 3 = 7 units/day

Work done in 4 days = 7 × 4 = 28 units

Work remaining = 60 − 28 = 32 units

Fraction remaining = 32 ÷ 60 = 8 ÷ 15

<svg width="550" height="260" viewBox="0 0 550 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  <line x1="20" y1="105" x2="480" y2="105" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,4" />

questions.question: A ring-shaped disc has outer radius 10 cm and inner radius 7 cm. What is the approximate ratio of the ring's area to the whole outer circle?
questions.questionHtml: A ring-shaped disc has outer radius 10 cm and inner radius 7 cm. What is the approximate ratio of the ring's area to the whole outer circle?
questions.solution:
Outer radius R = 10 cm

Inner radius r = 7 cm

Area of ring = π × (102 − 72)

Area of ring = π × (100 − 49)

Area of ring = 51π

Area of outer circle = π × 102

Area of outer circle = 100π

Required ratio = 51π : 100π

Required ratio = 51 : 100 ≈ 1:2

questions.question: A bicycle wheel having a radius of 35 cm. What percentage of its circumference is covered in a quarter turn? (Use π=22/7)
questions.questionHtml: A bicycle wheel having a radius of 35 cm. What percentage of its circumference is covered in a quarter turn? (Use π=22/7)
questions.solution:
Radius r = 35 cm

⇒ Circumference = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 35

⇒ Circumference = 220 cm

⇒ Distance covered in quarter turn = 220 ÷ 4

⇒ Distance covered = 55 cm

⇒ Percentage = (55 ÷ 220) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 25%
